body_markdown:
**Why DIYers Are Turning to Shed Kits Built with LP® SmartSide® Trim & Siding**


If you have been thinking about adding more storage, creating a hobby space, or building the workshop you have always wanted, a[DIY shed kit](https://www.yardlinesheds.com/) can be the perfect backyard project. When it comes to DIY-friendly shed solutions, Yardline has been helping customers build with confidence since 1978. Available exclusively through Costco, Yardline shed kits are designed for doers, dreamers, and weekend warriors who want a high-quality shed they can build themselves.


Yardline shed models feature LP® SmartSide® Trim & Siding, combining DIY-friendly installation with long-term durability and a beautiful wood-grain appearance. Yardline sheds highlight LP® SmartSide® Trim & Siding as a key component that helps protect against fungal decay, termites, and everyday wear.


**Built For DIY Success**


Not all siding materials are equally DIY-friendly. One of the reasons LP® SmartSide® Trim & Siding is a popular option for sheds is that it is designed to be easily installed.


For DIY builders, that means:


-


Easy cutting and installation


-


Lightweight materials


-


Resistant to cracking or breaking during installation


-


Panels are engineered to resist buckling


-


Primed with paint-ready surfaces


Whether you're a first-time builder or a weekend project enthusiast, these benefits can help make the shed-building process more approachable from the first panel to the final coat of paint.


**Built to Last**


A DIY project should feel rewarding. Yardline takes pride in creating quality shed kits optimized for DIY builders and LP helps support that experience with engineered performance and durability.


LP® SmartSide® Trim & Siding products are treated using the proprietary SmartGuard® process, helping protect against:


-


Fungal decay


-


Moisture


-


Termites


-


Hail impacts


This results in a shed exterior designed to help stand up to years of outdoor exposure while maintaining its appearance.


**A Finished Look for Your Backyard**


Many homeowners want a shed that looks like a natural extension of their home. LP® SmartSide® Trim & Siding features an attractive wood-grain texture that provides a warm, residential appearance, helping them blend naturally with the home. The product comes straight from the factory ready to be painted any color, making it easier to coordinate your shed with your home’s exterior, landscaping, or backyard aesthetic.


**Why Customers Choose Yardline**


For nearly five decades, Yardline has focused on developing DIY shed kits that help homeowners create functional outdoor spaces. Yardline proudly serves as an exclusive Costco partner and emphasizes quality construction and customer support.


Key reasons builders choose Yardline:


-


Designs specifically for DIY assembly


-


Building since 1978


-


Exclusive Costco partnership making it easy to purchase


Explore shed styles, how-to guides, and project inspiration at[https://www.yardlinesheds.com/](https://www.yardlinesheds.com/)
